title: SIIL SAMI JA ORAV OTT LENNUTAVAD LOHET

characters.name: SIIL SAMI
characters.description: Väike hall siil pehmete pruunide okastega (okkad on pruunid, mitte roosad), kandmas kollast kootud salli, suured armsad nööpsilmad ja rõõmus näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: ORAV OTT
characters.description: Väike oranž orav koheva sabaga, kandmas siniseid traksipükse, suurte uudishimulike silmade ja sõbraliku naeratusega. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Sügisene mäehari
locations.description: A grassy autumn hill under a cool blue sky with light fluffy clouds. Colorful trees with orange, yellow, and red leaves line the background below the hill. Green and golden grass on the ground, with a few fallen leaves scattered around. Bright daytime natural outdoor light. Simple clean cartoon background, cozy and friendly style.

pages.scene: Siil Sami and Orav Ott stand together on top of a grassy autumn hill. Sami is a small grey hedgehog wearing a yellow knitted scarf. Ott is a small orange squirrel with a fluffy tail wearing blue overalls. Green and golden grass underfoot with scattered colorful autumn leaves. Colorful trees in the distant background. They look out at the landscape with cheerful expressions. Warm autumn daylight. Sami: grey hedgehog with brown quills (not pink), yellow knitted scarf. Ott: orange squirrel with one single fluffy tail, blue overalls worn directly on his fur with no shirt or sleeves underneath. The kite is a solid red diamond-shaped kite (a filled rhombus, not a ring or hoop) with a long rainbow ribbon tail. The illustration fills the whole frame edge to edge, no band, strip or empty area at the bottom.
